| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | store |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | public function store(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse {     $user \= $request-\>user();     if ($event-\>participants()-\>where('user\_id', $user-\>id)-\>exists()) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'You are already enrolled in this event',         \], 409);     }     if ($event-\>max\_participants \> 0\) {         $attended \= $event-\>participants()-\>where('status', 'attended')-\>count();         if ($attended \>= $event-\>max\_participants) {             return response()-\>json(\[                 'success' \=\> false,                 'message' \=\> 'This event has reached its maximum participants',             \], 422);         }     }     if ($event-\>registration\_open && now()-\>lt($event-\>registration\_open)) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'Registration for this event has not opened yet',         \], 422);     }     if ($event-\>registration\_deadline && now()-\>gt($event-\>registration\_deadline)) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'Registration for this event has closed',         \], 422);     }     $participant \= $event-\>participants()-\>create(\[         'user\_id' \=\> $user-\>id,         'status' \=\> 'registered',     \]);     return response()-\>json(\[         'success' \=\> true,         'message' \=\> 'Successfully enrolled in event',         'data' \=\> $participant,     \], 201); } |  |

| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Mengubah status participant pada sebuah event. Hanya dapat dilakukan oleh organizer atau admin.  |
| **Method** |  | PATCH |
| **URL** |  | /api/events/{event}/participants/{participant} |
| **Headers** |  | Authorization: Bearer {token} Accept: application/json |
| **Body Request** |  | {     "status": "attended" } |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "success": true,     "message": "Participant status updated successfully",     "data": {         "id": 1,         "user\_id": 3,         "event\_id": 3,         "status": "attended",         "created\_at": "2026-05-05T06:09:13.000000Z",         "updated\_at": "2026-05-05T06:09:13.000000Z"     } } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "success": false,     "message": "Participant not found" } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image26]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | EventParticipantController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | update |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | public function update(Request $request, Event $event, EventParticipant $participant): JsonResponse {     if ($participant-\>event\_id \!= $event-\>id) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'Participant not found',         \], 404);     }     $validated \= $request-\>validate(\[         'status' \=\> \['required', Rule::in(\['registered', 'attended', 'absent'\])\],,     \]);     $participant-\>update($validated);     return response()-\>json(\[         'success' \=\> true,         'message' \=\> 'Participant status updated successfully',         'data' \=\> $participant,     \]); } |  |

   

5. Endpoint Event Participant \- Destroy (Unenroll)

| Nama Endpoint |  | Unenroll Event  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Membatalkan pendaftaran user yang sedang login dari sebuah event.  |
| **Method** |  | DELETE |
| **URL** |  | /api/events/{event}/enrol |
| **Headers** |  | Authorization: Bearer {token} Accept: application/json |
| **Body Request** |  | \- |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "success": true,     "message": "Successfully unenrolled from event",     "data": null } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "success": false,     "message": "You are not enrolled in this event" } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image27]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | EventParticipantController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | destroy |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | public function destroy(Request $request, Event $event): JsonResponse {     $participant \= $event-\>participants()-\>where('user\_id', $request-\>user()-\>id)-\>first();     if (\!$participant) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'You are not enrolled in this event',         \], 404);     }     $participant-\>delete();     return response()-\>json(\[         'success' \=\> true,         'message' \=\> 'Successfully unenrolled from event',         'data' \=\> null,     \]); } |  |

   ## 

6. ## Endpoint Event Participant \- My Events

| Nama Endpoint |  | Get My Enrolled Events  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Mengambil daftar event yang diikuti oleh user yang sedang login.  |
| **Method** |  | GET |
| **URL** |  | /api/my-events |
| **Headers** |  | Authorization: Bearer {token} Accept: application/json |
| **Body Request** |  | \- |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "success": true,     "message": "Enrolled events retrieved successfully",     "data": \[         {             "id": 1,             "user\_id": 3,             "event\_id": 3,             "status": "attended",             "created\_at": "2026-05-05T06:09:13.000000Z",             "updated\_at": "2026-05-05T06:09:13.000000Z",             "event": {                 "id": 3,                 "title": "Event Title",                 "location": "Jakarta"             }         }     \] } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "success": false,     "message": "Unauthenticated." } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image28]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | EventParticipantController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | myEvents |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | public function myEvents(Request $request): JsonResponse {     $participants \= $request-\>user()-\>participants()-\>with('event')-\>get();     return response()-\>json(\[         'success' \=\> true,         'message' \=\> 'Enrolled events retrieved successfully',         'data' \=\> $participants,     \]); } |  |

## 

6. ## Endpoint Kelompok

1. Endpoint Auth \- Register

| Nama Endpoint |  | Register User Baru |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Untuk mendaftarkan pengguna (user) baru ke dalam sistem dan database. |
| **Method** |  | POST |
| **URL** |  | /api/auth/register |
| **Headers** |  | Accept: application/json |
| **Body Request** |  | {     "name": "Mahasiswa Baru",     "email": "maba@example.com",     "password": "password123" } |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "success": true,     "message": "Register berhasil",     "data": {         "name": "Mahasiswa Baru",         "email": "maba@example.com",         "updated\_at": "2026-05-05T05:00:00.000000Z",         "created\_at": "2026-05-05T05:00:00.000000Z",         "id": 11     } } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "success": false,     "message": "Validasi gagal",     "errors": {         "email": \[             "The email has already been taken."         \]     } } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image29]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | AuthController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | register |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | \<?php public function register(Request $request) {     $validator \= Validator::make($request-\>all(), \[         'name' \=\> 'required',         'email' \=\> 'required|email|unique:users',         'password' \=\> 'required|min:6'     \]);     if ($validator-\>fails()) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'Validasi gagal',             'errors' \=\> $validator-\>errors()         \], 422);     }     // simpan user     $user \= User::create(\[         'name' \=\> $request-\>name,         'email' \=\> $request-\>email,         'password' \=\> Hash::make($request-\>password)     \]);     return response()-\>json(\[         'success' \=\> true,         'message' \=\> 'Register berhasil',         'data' \=\> $user     \], 201); } |  |

   

2. Endpoint Auth \- Login

| Nama Endpoint |  | Login & Get JWT Token |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Tujuan utama endpoint ini adalah mem-verifikasi akun/kredensial pengguna. Jika tepat, API akan mengembalikan JWT (JSON Web Token) yang nantinya dipakai sebagai Bearer Token untuk mengakses fungsi-fungsi spesifik selama divalidasi. |
| **Method** |  | POST |
| **URL** |  | /api/auth/login |
| **Headers** |  | Accept: application/json |
| **Body Request** |  | {     "email": "maba@example.com",     "password": "password123" } |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "access\_token": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbG...",     "token\_type": "bearer",     "roles": \[         "user"     \],     "expires\_in": 3600 } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "error": "Unauthorized" } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image30]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | AuthController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | login |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | \<?php public function login() {     $validator \= Validator::make(request()-\>all(), \[         'email' \=\> 'required|email',         'password' \=\> 'required'     \]);     if ($validator-\>fails()) {         return response()-\>json(\[             'success' \=\> false,             'message' \=\> 'Validasi gagal',             'errors' \=\> $validator-\>errors()         \], 422);     }     $credentials \= request(\['email', 'password'\]);     if (\!$token \= auth()-\>attempt($credentials)) {         return response()-\>json(\['error' \=\> 'Unauthorized'\], 401);     }     return $this-\>respondWithToken($token); } |  |

3. Endpoint Auth \- Profil

| Nama Endpoint |  | Get Current User Profile |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Mengambil informasi pengguna yang saat ini sedang terkoneksi/masuk di sistem (mengidentifikasinya lewat token JWT). |
| **Method** |  | POST |
| **URL** |  | /api/auth/me |
| **Headers** |  | Accept: application/json Authorization: Bearer {token\_jwt} |
| **Body Request** |  | \- |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "id": 11,     "name": "Mahasiswa Baru",     "email": "maba@example.com",     "email\_verified\_at": null,     "created\_at": "2026-05-05T05:00:00.000000Z",     "updated\_at": "2026-05-05T05:00:00.000000Z" } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "message": "Unauthenticated." } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image31]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | AuthController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | me |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | \<?php public function me() {     return response()-\>json(auth()-\>user()); } |  |

4. Endpoint Auth \- Refresh

| Nama Endpoint |  | Refresh JWT Token |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Memperbarui batas waktu kedaluwarsa kredensial. Jika token user hampir habis masa waktu aktifnya (expires), panggil endpoint ini (mengirimkan token lama) untuk dibuatkan token identitas yang durasinya baru (diperpanjang) tanpa harus mengisi email/password ulang (re-login). |
| **Method** |  | POST |
| **URL** |  | /api/auth/refresh |
| **Headers** |  | Accept: application/json Authorization: Bearer {token\_jwt} |
| **Body Request** |  | \- |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "access\_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR...",     "token\_type": "bearer",     "roles": null,     "expires\_in": 3600 } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "message": "Unauthenticated." } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image32]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | AuthController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | refresh |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | \<?php public function refresh() {     return $this-\>respondWithToken(auth()-\>refresh()); } |  |

   

5. Endpoint Auth \- Logout

| Nama Endpoint |  | Logout / Invalidate Token |
| ----- | :---- | :---- |
| **Tujuan Endpoint** |  | Melakukan logout dan menghancurkan (invalidate) JWT Access Token secara permanen sehingga token tersebut tidak bisa dipakai lagi (sebagai bagian dari keamanan jika user memencet tombol log-out dari aplikasi). |
| **Method** |  | POST |
| **URL** |  | /api/auth/logout |
| **Headers** |  | Accept: application/json Authorization: Bearer {token\_jwt} |
| **Body Request** |  | \- |
| **Response Sukses** |  | {     "message": "Successfully logged out" } |
| **Response Gagal** |  | {     "message": "Unauthenticated." } |
| **Screenshot Hasil** |  |  |
| **![][image33]** |  |  |
| **Class Controller** |  | AuthController |
| **Fungsi Class Controller** |  | logout |
| **Code Fungsi** |  |  |
|  | \<?php public function logout() {     auth()-\>logout();     return response()-\>json(\['message' \=\> 'Successfully logged out'\]); } |  |
